part: 605-2211-110F - green, a 3 mm LED recessed in a chrome M5 panel housing
package: PANEL MOUNT, wired: D5.2 hole, M5x0.5 nut and lock washer, through-hole leads
notes: LIT = THE LOAD SWITCH IS DELIVERING: it hangs on the LT1641's output (UMBILICAL_POS12), so it goes dark with the toggle off and when the -1 latches on a fault - the one thing the panel has to say. It does not say the instrument is plugged in; that is the instrument's to report. PANEL-MOUNTED (ADR 0024 point 16): in the panel's led.hole_d hole (config/module.yaml), its head on the face, held by its own nut on the rear face; nothing of it is on a board. MARK THE ANODE BEFORE CUTTING THE LEADS - the dot on the housing's back [ds DIALIGHT-605-SERIES-PMI-CATALOG-2021-EXCERPT.pdf] - then cut them to led.lead_cut, solder CBL-LED-PANEL's red wire to the anode and its black to the cathode, and sleeve both joints. TWO BANKED CATALOGUES DISAGREE ON THIS PART NUMBER: 2 V, 15 mA, 70 mcd typ [ds DIALIGHT-605-SERIES-PMI-CATALOG-2021-EXCERPT.pdf] against 3 V, 20 mA, 900-1400 mcd, an InGaN die [ds DIALIGHT-605-SERIES-PMI-CATALOG-2026-EXCERPT.pdf p.2]; R-LED-PANEL holds either inside the panel-led sim's range (hardware/module/panel-led/sim). Stock: Mouser listed it [web search 2026-10-01]. How bright it looks at its current is the first build's to see

About 4 mA from the load switch's output (UMBILICAL_POS12) into LED-PANEL through J-LED-PANEL, on the main board beside the header. Not from the analog +12 V: that rail is live whenever the rack is, so the LED could not show a latch

LCSC C158012 [web search 2026-10-01]. ON THE MAIN BOARD'S FRONT FACE, below the LED (ADR 0024 point 16; mechanical/module/export/pcb-geometry.echo 'J-LED-PANEL'): PIN 1 = LED_ANODE, PIN 2 = AGND_MOD - put 1 and A on the silk by pin 1. Polarised by its shroud. Its height with the XHP-2 mated and the room above it for the wires are mechanical/module/drc.echo 'J-LED-PANEL's mated housing behind the panel'; its tails on the rear face are below U-ISO's body ('main board rear-face parts clear of each other')

part: LED lead: JST XHP-2 housing, 2 x SXH-001T-P0.6 crimp, 26 AWG red and black
notes: XHP-2 is LCSC C144401, SXH-001T-P0.6 is LCSC C140573, two per lead [web search 2026-10-01]; they need the XH crimp tool. RED WIRE IN XHP-2 CIRCUIT 1, the anode, to J-LED-PANEL pin 1; black in circuit 2, the cathode. Length led.cable_l, crimp to joint (config/module.yaml); the run as laid and what folds into the gap are mechanical/module/drc.echo 'CBL-LED-PANEL's run, LED to header'. The far ends are soldered to LED-PANEL's cut leads and sleeved. PLUG IT IN BEFORE the main board goes onto the panel studs (ROADMAP, the module's build)
